international.title: ‘Victory for democracy’: Taiwan’s ruling party secures best result in a decade
international.summary: DPP nearly doubles number of constituencies it controls, with outcome expected to anger Beijing Taiwan’s ruling party secured its best result in a decade in Saturday’s local elections , nearly doubling the number of constituencies it controls, in an outcome expected to anger Beijing. The Democratic Progressive party (DPP) won at least nine of Taiwan’s 22 mayoral and county magistrate races, up from five in its disastrous showing in the last local elections four years ago.
